runtime_boundary.collector_receives: only values already present at the named runtime seam
runtime_boundary.product_failure_policy: fail open; decision result and provider/M1 behavior remain unchanged
runtime_boundary.diagnostic_failure_policy: mandatory provenance loss invalidates causal diagnosis for the affected case/run under a precommitted completeness gate

retention.raw_sql: do not duplicate immutable memory/reference SQL; retain hashes and stable IDs
retention.raw_provider_output: bounded assistant content in diagnostic ledger only
retention.results: bounded result metadata and existing evaluator hashes; no unrestricted rows

hash_policy: canonical UTF-8 JSON with sorted object keys, preserved meaningful list order, explicit nulls, no timestamps in semantic hashes
offline_diagnostics: semantic comparison against benchmark truth after runtime capture
readiness_gate: all mandatory fields present for 100% of cases in a future fresh diagnostic run before causal mechanism conclusions are accepted
